title: There was a loan approved in 1994/8/25, where was that account opened, give
question: There was a loan approved in 1994/8/25, where was that account opened, give the district Id of the branch.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T3.district_id
FROM loan AS T1
INNER JOIN AccountDate AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN DistrictReference AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND T1.status = 'A'
